title: Grok pager appearance configuration (~/.grok/pager.toml)
description: Schema for ~/.grok/pager.toml (path resolved via display_user_grok_path("pager.toml") [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager-render/src/appearance/config.rs:1790]), the pager-owned, hot-reloadable appearance/rendering config. Models the TOML-facing RawAppearanceConfig [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager-render/src/appearance/config.rs:728-749]; every section carries #[serde(default)] so any subset of keys is valid and an empty file is valid. No struct uses deny_unknown_fields, so unknown keys are tolerated everywhere. The settings-modal registry (crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager/src/settings/) is deliberately NOT part of this schema: 43 of its 46 entries persist into [ui]/[cli]/[toolset.ask_user_question] of ~/.grok/config.toml (see grok-config.schema.json); the single registry entry that writes to pager.toml is [scrollback.scroll].respect_manual_folds.

disable_plugins.description: Disable hooks & plugins UI (/hooks and /plugins commands, scrollback annotations). [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager-render/src/appearance/config.rs:742-744]

show_plan_chip.description: Always show the "plan" chip in the status bar when plan content is available, even after the user exits plan mode. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager-render/src/appearance/config.rs:745-748]

optionalColor.description: OptionalColor: "none"/"null" (case-insensitive) for no override, a named palette color (e.g. "BLUE", "CYAN", "MAGENTA", "COMMENT"; case-insensitive, GrokNight palette), a hex string ("#rrggbb" or "#rgb"), or an [r, g, b] array of three 0-255 integers. An unrecognized color name or malformed hex FAILS the parse. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager-render/src/appearance/config.rs:1614-1695]

oneOf.description: "none"/"null", "#rgb"/"#rrggbb" hex, or a named palette color. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager-render/src/appearance/config.rs:1663-1695]

alt_screen.description: Alt-screen (fullscreen) policy: "auto" = fullscreen in plain terminals and normal tmux, inline in tmux control mode and Zellij; "always"; "never". Any other string fails the parse (typed enum). [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager-render/src/appearance/config.rs:758-763,784-795]

minimal.description: Experimental scrollback-native rendering mode: finalized blocks are printed into the terminal's native scrollback. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager-render/src/appearance/config.rs:764-766]

minimal_max_commit_rows.description: Maximum rows for a single committed block in minimal mode. Optional; default-at-use 2000. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager-render/src/appearance/config.rs:769-770]

fps.description: Animation frame rate (ticks per second). Higher = smoother but more CPU. Documented range 1-60, clamped at use; serde accepts any u8 (0-255). [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager-render/src/appearance/config.rs:1079-1081,1093]

wave_rows.description: Rows per wave cycle for accent line animation. Lower = faster wave; min 1 applied at use. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager-render/src/appearance/config.rs:1082-1084,1094]

show_fps.description: Show an FPS counter overlay in the top-right corner. Requires a debug build; also enabled by GROK_FPS=1. [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager-render/src/appearance/config.rs:1085-1087,1095]
